a deep learning based model can be trained to recognize Indian Sign Language gestures in real time with high accuracy.
a real time hand based gesture recognition model can be built for ISL alphabets and words, and the model is transferable to ASL.

developing a robust system for ISL gesture recognition and sentence formation.
the development of a real time hand sign gesture recognition system that can be deployed in the future to assist speech impaired people in communicating.
building an end to end system for ISL gesture recognition using computer vision techniques, CNNs and Convolutional L STMs.
